sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: release-tracks: the "Recording date" column's 📊 dropdown never showed the "Date info - Precision/Decade/Month/Year/Weekday" section family every other date-bearing column gets. That family is gated on a column's name appearing in a declarative `columnExtractors`/`syntheticColumnExtractors` entry with `extractor: 'dateParts'`, but "Recording date" is built entirely inside `applyExtractTrackTitleData()`'s bespoke AR-column pipeline, outside that mechanism, so it was never registered. Its `<th>`-creation site now also registers the name (with an empty `syntheticColumns`, so it can never inject an unwanted derived column) — the same "column whose existence isn't known at authoring time" registration pattern `_picardRegisterCollapsableColumn()` already uses.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The "Release info - Data quality" 📊 dropdown section never appeared on a relationship listing's "Title" column (e.g. an artist's Relationships tab) even when the relationship's target is a release carrying MusicBrainz's own native high/low-data-quality marker — the section's eligibility check was gated on the column being literally named "Release", which a relationship-target column never is (it can point to any entity kind, so MusicBrainz always calls it "Title"). The gate now also accepts "Title", additionally checking each cell's own native `<span class="releaselink">` marker so a relationship targeting a non-release entity is never miscounted as "normal quality".
